name: claymorphism-ui
description: Claymorphic restyling — the soft-and-physical language in which the surface carries ITS OWN PASTEL FILL, distinct from the page ground and inflated at a large radius. Emits a pastel token layer whose shadow atoms are hue-derived from each surface own fill, rewrites components to the four-layer rim/sheen/shade/drop stack with the squish press, gives static panels a reduced treatment so affordance survives, inverts the recipe for inputs, and self-audits every emitted pair against WCAG 2.2. A surface matching the page ground is neumorphism-ui; one imitating a material is skeuomorphism-ui.
